name: bookshelf-tests
description: AsayakeBookshelf のテスト用 devDependencies (アプリ本体はビルドレス。<script> 構成に node は不要)

scripts.audit:a11y-names: playwright test -c playwright.audit.config.js --output=test-results-audit/a11y tests/audit/a11y-names.spec.js && node scripts/check-audit.mjs a11y
scripts.audit:buttons: node scripts/extract-ui-strings.mjs && playwright test -c playwright.audit.config.js --output=test-results-audit/buttons tests/audit/button-names.spec.js && node scripts/check-audit.mjs buttons
scripts.audit:layout: playwright test -c playwright.audit.config.js --output=test-results-audit/layout tests/audit/layout.spec.js && node scripts/check-audit.mjs layout
